conventions: Format all TypeScript, JavaScript, JSON, and Markdown files with Prettier (@backstage/cli/config/prettier: 2-space indent, single quotes in TS/JS, trailing commas).
Never run lint commands with --fix; never run yarn build, changesets version, or release.
Every new source file must start with the standard Backstage Apache 2.0 copyright header (Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors).
Workspace package.json peerDependencies for @types/react, react, and react-dom must be exactly "^18.0.0".
Author changesets directly as Markdown files in .changeset/ (never via the changeset CLI) and exclude private packages (app-example-plugin, @internal/plugin-todo-list).

decisions.topic: React peerDependency range across workspace packages and repo-tools peer-deps linter
decisions.choice: Set @types/react, react, and react-dom in peerDependencies to '^18.0.0' in all 56 workspace package.json files and in packages/repo-tools/src/commands/peer-deps/peer-deps.ts, removing peerDependenciesReact18Only, react18OnlyPackages, and getExpectedPeerDependencies.
rejected: Retaining react18OnlyPackages with all packages added to the set
decisions.reason: All published frontend packages now uniformly require React 18, making the per-package React 18 allowlist redundant while keeping React 19 out of scope.

decisions.topic: React 18 root mounting in dev-utils, frontend-dev-utils, and plugin-techdocs
decisions.choice: Use unconditional const ReactDOMPromise = import('react-dom/client') and ReactDOMPromise.then(({ createRoot }) => createRoot(...).render(...)) in render.tsx, createDevApp.tsx, and renderReactElement.ts.
rejected: Keeping conditional HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT or 'createRoot' in ReactDOM checks
Switching to synchronous top-level createRoot imports where async import('react-dom/client') is expected
decisions.reason: Preserves the existing asynchronous module loading and knip/jest-mock contracts under React 18 while eliminating all React 17 ReactDOM.render fallback branches and HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT checks.

decisions.topic: useSyncExternalStore import source and dependency cleanup
decisions.choice: Import useSyncExternalStore directly from 'react' in useRouteRef.tsx and useBreakpoint.ts, remove use-sync-external-store and @types/use-sync-external-store from frontend-plugin-api, ui, and plugins/app package.json files, and refresh yarn.lock via a yarn install tooling unit.
rejected: Keeping use-sync-external-store/shim as a wrapper around React.useSyncExternalStore
decisions.reason: useSyncExternalStore is built into React 18, so the external shim package and its type definitions are no longer needed.

decisions.topic: Changeset versioning and 6-file split for affected published packages
decisions.choice: Create six changeset files in .changeset/ (one per distinct adopter-facing message in plain adopter language with no internal code symbols): (a) .changeset/require-react-18.md for the 54 published packages narrowing React peer ranges to ^18.0.0 (major for 17 packages >= 1.0.0, minor for 37 packages < 1.0.0), (b) .changeset/test-utils-remove-legacy-root.md for @backstage/test-utils removing the legacyRoot render option (major), (c) .changeset/cli-drop-react-17.md for @backstage/cli-module-build and @backstage/cli-module-test-jest dropping React 17 support in build and test tooling (minor), (d) .changeset/cli-new-react-18-templates.md for @backstage/cli-module-new templates generating packages that require React 18 (patch), (e) .changeset/repo-tools-peer-deps-react-18.md for @backstage/repo-tools peer-deps check requiring ^18.0.0 ranges (minor), and (f) .changeset/ui-dependency-cleanup.md for @backstage/ui dependency cleanup (patch).
rejected: Putting all 59 packages into a single changeset file with a combined message
Giving @backstage/cli-module-new a minor bump when template updates do not break existing adopters
Naming internal code symbols or including private packages app-example-plugin and @internal/plugin-todo-list
decisions.reason: AGENTS.md and REVIEWING.md require each changeset to be specific to its packages and written for adopters without internal code symbols, and template updates in @backstage/cli-module-new are non-breaking (patch).

sites.first_line: - **If you are already using the New JSX Transform:** You are not impacted by this change, regardless of your React version (17, 18, or when 19 becomes available for Backstage).
sites.last_line: - **If you are NOT using the New JSX Transform (likely if you're importing React like `import React from 'react'`):** You will need to adopt it before upgrading to React 19. This typically involves changing your imports, as the New JSX Transform doesn't require importing the entire React namespace to use JSX. This is recommended even on React 17 or 18, as it was a change introduced with React 17. Although a best practice since React 17, Backstage did not adopt this transform when it upgraded.
